g.text: LoanWatch BI | Vendor Feed Delivery SLA & Data Quality Governance
FirstMark Servicing Feed Audits • 12 Rule Pass % • Negative Testing Quarantine Breakdown
1.68 GB Raw Source Ingested (30 Canonical Cols)
Tagged with pipe-delimited rule reason codes
Vendor Feed Gatekeeper & Negative-Testing Audit Log (11 Batch Runs)
Green: On-Time Pass • Orange: Late Pass • Red: Quarantined (Exit Codes 10, 11, 12, 13, 20)
Evaluated in PySpark local mode across 5 dimensions • SLA Threshold: 99.0%–99.95%
Vendor Feed Service Level Agreement (SLA) & Operational Exit Code Contract
SOP reference: docs/RUNBOOK.md • Automated notifications routed to reports/alerts/ upon breach
sha256sum does not match manifest SHA256 (corrupt or truncated)
Quarantine drop; notify vendor to re-transmit intact file
wc -l data rows != manifest EXPECTED_ROWS (valid SHA-256)
Verify generator script; request revised manifest from servicer
Column count != 30 or column names drift from expected_columns.txt
Raise upstream change ticket; block until schema alignment is agreed
PySpark row-level failure rate exceeds MAX_REJECT_PCT (5.0%)
Inspect scorecard; sample reason codes; escalate to vendor steward
Feed file missing at 06:30 IST cron trigger (or arrival mtime > 06:30 IST)
P2 escalation at 06:45 IST; ingest with LATE flag once landed
